_provenance: Sanitised shape of the live `Pin` push observed in research 0.2 (2026-11-27): pin of message B replacing pinned message A, B being OLDER than A. Rebuilt from the recorded shape because the raw capture was not stored; ids and timestamps are placeholders, no message text, no tokens. ServerMessageInfo.Timestamp is the pinned message's own timestamp; the action time is LastEditTimestamp (= Version) and is newer than the previous pin's.
